testcase.name: Construction: anchor required, anchorTicks and rate finite; start() is local 0, rate 1, playing (sections 4, 7)
withRate keeps the value continuous at the switch instant; negative rates reverse; rate 0 freezes without pausing (section 4)
COSMETIC playback runs at one local tick per 50 ms of supplied nanoseconds (sections 3, 4)
localTicks = anchorTicks + rate * ticksSince(anchor); integer data give exact integers (sections 4, 6.3)
seek sets the value at the instant and keeps rate and pause state; restart is local 0, playing, same rate (section 4)
pause on a paused playback and resume on a playing one return the same object (idempotent), after validating the instant (section 4)
Unrepresentable results: instant overflow while playing and a non-finite re-anchored value are ArithmeticExceptions (sections 4, 7)
Control instants: same domain, not before the anchor (equal allowed); localTicks also validates its domain (sections 4, 7)
pause holds the value exactly, even far in the future; resume continues from it; a paused span adds exactly nothing (section 4)
